name: Tarot Card
overview: Scripture clearly warns against seeking guidance from familiar spirits, wizards, or any form of occult practices, as seen in Leviticus 19:31 and 20:6, where God commands His people to avoid defilement through such means. The Israelites are instructed not to adopt the abominable customs of surrounding nations (Deuteronomy 18:9), which includes divination and signs from false prophets (Deuteronomy 13:1). While Mark 13:1 acknowledges the awe of physical structures, it implicitly directs attention away from worldly signs to the authority of God. Therefore, the use of tarot cards, which involve seeking supernatural insight apart from God, stands in opposition to biblical commands and reverence for the Lord.
